name: data-lineage-viz
description: Visualize object dependencies and data lineage from .dacpac files or by importing from SQL Server, Azure SQL, Fabric DW, and Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool databases

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Custom parse-rule, DMV query, exclusion-pattern and AI template settings are read from workspace configuration and compiled or executed; workspace values for them are ignored until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: Data Lineage: Create AI Output Templates
Data Lineage: Show AI Trace in Graph
Data Lineage: Enable AI Trace Logging for This Session
Data Lineage: Dump AI State Machine

dataLineageViz.maxNodes.markdownDescription: Maximum objects (10–5000) loaded into the graph, external references included. A larger selection is refused; select fewer schemas or raise this limit.

dataLineageViz.renderLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum nodes drawn at once; above it the graph shows a notice instead.

dataLineageViz.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Case-insensitive regular expressions for objects to hide on every load, matched against `schema.name`; `%` matches any text. Reload the data source to apply. [Details](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#settings-reference)

dataLineageViz.externalRefs.enabled.markdownDescription: Show OPENROWSET paths and cross-database names as virtual external nodes. Reload the data source to apply.

dataLineageViz.overview.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow Schema View. When off, graphs always open in Object View.

dataLineageViz.overview.threshold.markdownDescription: Object count above which a graph opens in Schema View instead of Object View; the effective value is capped at `renderLimit`. [Details](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#settings-reference)

enumDescriptions: Add the schema to Expanded Schema View.
Make the schema the only one expanded.
dataLineageViz.overview.schemaDoubleClic.markdownDescription: What double-clicking a schema node does in Schema View.

dataLineageViz.parseRulesFile.markdownDescription: Path to a custom parse rules YAML file; empty uses the built-in rules. [Customization guide](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/PARSE_RULES.md)

dataLineageViz.dmvQueryTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout in seconds per metadata query. Raise it for large databases.

dataLineageViz.dmvQueriesFile.markdownDescription: Path to a custom DMV queries YAML file; empty uses the built-in queries. [Customization guide](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/DMV_QUERIES.md)

dataLineageViz.database.connections.markdownDescription:
Saved database connections; passwords stay in VS Code secure storage.

**Manage:** [Add](command:dataLineageViz.addDatabaseConnection) · [Edit](command:dataLineageViz.editDatabaseConnection) · [Update Password](command:dataLineageViz.updateDatabasePassword) · [Remove](command:dataLineageViz.removeDatabaseConnection)

id.markdownDescription: Stable identifier; also names the secret-store entry of the password.

database.description: Database to open. Leave empty to choose at connect time.

authenticationType.description: Sign-in type. Windows authentication is not supported.
enumDescriptions: SQL Server login with user name and password.
Microsoft Entra ID sign-in through VS Code.

accountId.description: Id of the Microsoft account in VS Code to sign in with.

tenantId.description: Microsoft Entra tenant id to sign in to.

trustServerCertificate.description: Trust the server certificate without validation. Use only for servers you control.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show column statistics and row counts in the table details panel (live database only).

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.standardM.markdownDescription: Offer Standard profiling mode (more statistics, heavier queries). Off leaves only Quick mode.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.excludeEx.markdownDescription: Skip statistics for external tables, whose queries may read slow or costly remote data sources.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.queryTime.markdownDescription: Timeout in seconds per profiling query.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.sampleThr.markdownDescription: Row count above which a table is sampled instead of fully scanned; `0` samples every non-empty table.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.sampleSiz.markdownDescription: Approximate number of rows sampled from a table above the sample threshold.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.useApprox.markdownDescription: Count distinct values with `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` (faster, about 2% error). Needs SQL Server 2019 or later; turn off on older versions.

dataLineageViz.tableStatistics.maxColumn.markdownDescription: Maximum columns profiled per table; the rest are skipped.

dataLineageViz.layout.edgeAnimation.markdownDescription: Animate edges while a trace runs.

dataLineageViz.layout.highlightAnimation.markdownDescription: Animate edges when you click a node.

dataLineageViz.layout.rankSeparation.markdownDescription: Gap between dependency layers, in pixels.

dataLineageViz.layout.nodeSeparation.markdownDescription: Gap between nodes within a layer, in pixels.

dataLineageViz.trace.defaultUpstreamLeve.markdownDescription: Upstream (input) levels a trace starts with.

dataLineageViz.trace.defaultDownstreamLe.markdownDescription: Downstream (output) levels a trace starts with.

dataLineageViz.analysis.hubMinDegree.markdownDescription: Minimum connections for an object to count as a hub.

dataLineageViz.analysis.islandMaxSize.markdownDescription: Largest connected group reported as an island; lower it to list only small groups.

dataLineageViz.analysis.longestPathMinNo.markdownDescription: Minimum objects a chain needs to appear in longest-path analysis.

dataLineageViz.ai.enabled.description: Turn the AI chat panel and its tools on or off (the MCP server follows dataLineageViz.mcp.enabled). Reload the window after changing.

dataLineageViz.ai.maxRounds.markdownDescription: Maximum rounds per AI deep analysis; each procedure, view or function it reads takes one round.

dataLineageViz.ai.maxTraceColumns.markdownDescription: Maximum starting columns one AI column trace may follow.

dataLineageViz.ai.discoveryNodeCap.markdownDescription: Maximum scope objects in one AI catalog request; above it, a deep analysis is offered for your approval.

dataLineageViz.ai.discoveryTokenBudget.markdownDescription: Estimated DDL token limit for one AI catalog request, capped at one eighth of the model's input window; above it, a deep analysis is offered for your approval. [Details](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#settings-reference)

dataLineageViz.ai.outputTemplateFile.markdownDescription: Path to a custom AI output templates YAML file; empty uses the built-in templates. [Customization guide](https://github.com/ChrisDevRepo/vscode_data_lineage/blob/main/docs/AI_PROMPTS.md)

dataLineageViz.ai.models.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible model endpoints the assistant can use (Chat Completions or Responses). Keys never belong here: run [Set API key](command:dataLineageViz.setApiKey) per entry. An invalid entry is named and not offered.

id.markdownDescription: Stable identifier; also names the secret-store entry of the key.

url.markdownDescription: Base URL of the API, e.g. `https://host/openai/v1/`; https, or http on 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1]. No query string.

model.description: Model name sent in the request.

maxInputTokens.description: Input window of the model in tokens.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output limit of the model in tokens; sent as `max_output_tokens` on Responses only.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent with each request.

forcedToolChoice.description: Whether the endpoint accepts a forced tool choice; when off, `auto` is sent.

requestBody.markdownDescription: Extra request parameters, sent unchanged. `model`, `messages`, `input`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, `stream` and `stream_options` are owned by the extension.

requestHeaders.description: Extra request headers. Never a key.

dataLineageViz.ai.defaultModel.markdownDescription: The `id` of the `ai.models` entry used by default.

dataLineageViz.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve the read-only lineage tools to local AI clients (VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI) over a local MCP server on 127.0.0.1. Independent of `dataLineageViz.ai.enabled`. Run **Data Lineage: Enable MCP Server** to turn it on, or **Data Lineage: Copy MCP Config** for clients outside VS Code.

dataLineageViz.mcp.port.markdownDescription: Port of the local MCP server. The first VS Code window takes it; other windows report that it is in use.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
scripts.test:core: node tests/tools/run-vitest.mjs run tests/unit/parser tests/unit/engine tests/unit/webview
scripts.coverage:core: node tests/tools/run-vitest.mjs run --coverage tests/unit/parser tests/unit/engine tests/unit/webview
